name: Hip Circle
steps: Stand tall with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width, knees soft, and hands resting comfortably on your hips.
Shift your hips smoothly forward, out to one side, backward, and around to the other side in a wide, even circle.
Keep your head and shoulders relatively quiet while gliding smoothly through the full comfortable arc of your hips.
Continue circling evenly in one direction before reversing direction cleanly for the target duration.
tips: Keep both feet planted flat on the floor and move through a smooth, pain-free range.
Avoid snapping your lower back forward at the front of each circle.
